details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. Citations [1] and [3] show Lake Powell was above 3,550 feet on dates in August 2025. 2. Citation [5] shows the highest annual elevation listed for 2026 was 3,540.17 feet, below the threshold. 3. However, the citations do not show that August 22 was the last date above 3,550 feet during 2025; the annual 2025 summary gives no timing for its maximum. Thus the claim that August 2025 was the last time is not fully established.
